ei.subject: 10월_2024 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 24번 — AI as a Partner for Co-evolution

fullPassage: The evolution of AI is often associated with the concept of singularity. Singularity refers to the point at which AI exceeds human intelligence. After that point, it is predicted that AI will repeatedly improve itself and evolve at an accelerated pace. When AI becomes self-aware and pursues its own goals, it will be a conscious being, not just a machine. AI and human consciousness will then begin to evolve together. Our consciousness will evolve to new dimensions through our interactions with AI, which will provide us with intellectual stimulation and inspire new insights and creativity. Conversely, our consciousness also has a significant impact on the evolution of AI. The direction of AI's evolution will depend greatly on what values and ethics we incorporate into AI. We need to see our relationship with AI as a mutual coexistence of conscious beings, recognizing its rights and supporting the evolution of its consciousness.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: that → which: 콤마(,) 뒤 계속적 용법에서는 관계대명사 that을 쓸 수 없음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

밑줄 친 evolve to new dimensions는 AI와의 상호작용으로 지적 자극과 새 통찰을 얻어 의식이 '더 높은 차원'으로 성장함을 비유합니다.

② a different physical place to live in (살 수 있는 다른 물리적 장소) — dimensions를 물리적 공간으로 오해
③ a return to a simpler, earlier state (더 단순한 이전 상태로의 회귀) — 진화(발전)와 반대
④ the measuring of objects in three sizes (사물을 세 가지 크기로 측정) — 문자적 오해
